summary: Sheffield Pharmaceuticals is a United States manufacturer of over-the-counter pharmaceutical products sold to retailers. It makes and sells goods under its own labels as well as privately for other companies, and it operates as an FDA-registered cGMP facility. The note also says the company was founded in 1880 as the Sheffield Dentifrice Company by Washington Sheffield, described as the inventor of modern toothpaste.
one_line: Sheffield Pharmaceuticals is a US over-the-counter drug manufacturer, founded in 1880 as the Sheffield Dentifrice Company.
key_facts: Sheffield Pharmaceuticals is a manufacturer of over the counter pharmaceutical products to retailers in the United States.
Sheffield Pharmaceuticals manufactures and sells products under its own labels.
Sheffield Pharmaceuticals manufactures and sells products privately for other companies.
Sheffield Pharmaceuticals is an FDA registered cGMP facility.
Sheffield Pharmaceuticals was founded as the Sheffield Dentifrice Company.
The Sheffield Dentifrice Company was founded by Washington Sheffield.
Washington Sheffield is described in the note as the inventor of modern toothpaste.
